description: This file defines an abstract base class for responses to common commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides common properties and methods for such responses, including resource type and resource path management.

classes.name: CommonCommandResponse
classes.description: An abstract class providing base implementation for responses to CommonCommand instances, encapsulating common properties like resource type and resource path.

methods.name: CommonCommandResponse
methods.description: Constructor initializing the response with response type, HTTP status code, and headers.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns an empty JsonPointer instance indicating the resource path for the response.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the string 'common' as the resource type for this response.

calls: super(String responseType, HttpStatusCode statusCode, DittoHeaders dittoHeaders)
